glbPatch.reason: 2026-10-02 user: the four-legged sit idle (14ab695470) is not approved - the idle must stay HoMM3-authentic, and the rearing stance kept stiff forelimbs 'like its miming the air'. Op 1 restores the DEF rampant stand of 04d8d99ff1 (sitRepose: lean 20 deg forward and lower 0.06 H about the hind hips with the hind feet IK-planted, neck +20 / head +40 so the beak leads the chest, wings swept back 40, left foreleg raised 30); the four-legged foreLegs op is dropped. Cause of the miming: the staticCapture build holds Arm/ForeArm/Hand at rest or fixed flightLife offsets, so the forelegs stay rigid against the chest on every sit clip while the DEF moves shoulder, elbow, wrist and talons every frame. Op 2 (keyRotations): per-DEF-frame rotation offsets on both foreleg chains (Arm, ForeArm, Hand), fitted on GPU to hand-placed DEF foreleg keypoints (forearm and talon direction plus wrist/talon position after a per-frame torso shift, skin-stretch penalty, 95 deg soft cap), interpolated onto each clip's own key grid; loop clips ease back to frame 0. Body, hind legs, wings, tail and Move root motion are untouched. Numpy patch lane. 2026-10-04 user: 'the griffin animation seems completely wrong, including the idle pose'. Op 3 (keyRotations, body): per-DEF-frame local rotation offsets on the whole skeleton (hips, spine, neck, head, shoulders/forelegs, all wing joints, hind legs, tail) fitted on GPU to every DEF plate of every clip (silhouette inside/cover, colour regions, hand-placed beak/head/thigh/tail/wing keypoints, hind feet planted, wing mirror symmetry, skin-stretch penalty) with one shared fixed camera, so the rampant upright stand, folded upright wings, rear-up/lunge attack, wing-raised defence and hit recoil follow the DEF instead of the leaned sit. DEF frames pixel-identical to idle frame 0 (start/end of mouseover, move start/end, hit, defence, attack, death) take the exact fitted idle frame-0 pose. Sparse 2-key channels (Spine/Spine2/Shoulder/ForeArm/Hand/Wing_01 holds) are resampled onto the clip grid (regrid: true) so their per-frame offsets survive (not on Unit_Move, whose densified key sets must stay on the densify stride). Unit_Move wing joints keep the v4 flight beat (the fitted Move wings fell under the 60 deg wing-swing floor). Royal: the fit view is pinned to the board camera (config yaw -100, no elevation) because a free camera drifted to a 28 deg low view and fitted upright poses as fallen; idle frame 0 and its anchors are eased 15% toward v4 to stay under the worst-edge stretch rule. 2026-10-07 authenticity pass (lane-A): rest-pose wings lengthened 1.22x (meshSurgery); op 2 regrid: true (the rebuild's Mouseover forelimb channels are 2-key holds); keyTranslations keeps the fitted Hips path; op 4 body table = the v8 DEF fit transferred onto the rebuilt base keys plus a gate-aware refit of Defence/Hitted, attenuated by the stretch gate (candidate cand_w5; all clips still under review). 2026-10-07 lane-A attempt 4: body table w10 = w5 + AttackFront refit on the lifted Hips (folded-wing lunge kept, f3-f5 frozen in the gate), Death refit seeded with a -110 deg Hips roll (backward tumble onto its back), Defence refit (w-cover 3, w-sym 1: far wing raised). 2026-10-07 lane-A attempt 5: body table w13 = w10 + Hitted refit (w-cover 3, w-sym 1, w-kp 1.5: wings spread and raised f1-f5, anchors f0/f6 kept), Move refit (w-cover 3, w-sym 5, w-kp 1.5: f0/f2 glide wings level and swept back, f1 downstroke), Death refit (w-kp 1.5; anchor f0 kept). w15b: + AttackFront refit (w-kp 1.5, w-cover 3, w-inside 8; f0/f8 anchors kept, f3-f5 frozen in the gate: f4 lunge extends forward) and MoveEnd refit (w-kp 1.5, w-cover 3; anchor f3 kept). w17: + Death and Hitted refits with the hind toes freed and a capture hinge-delta term on Neck/Head/feet/toes (rubric 3a; anchors kept): toes and feet now articulate, Death f5 head held up.
